title: Tripo launches early access to UV unwrap and retopology
summary: Tripo opened early access to automated UV unwrapping and retopology tools, integrating low-poly mesh conversion and UV layout generation directly into its 3D modeling workflow.
research_notes:
Generate a 3D asset from a text description or 2D image prompt within Tripo.

Execute automated retopology to convert the dense generated mesh into an optimized quad or triangle structure with user-defined polygon limits.

Apply automated UV unwrapping to calculate seams, pack 2D UV islands, and rebake texture maps onto the unwrapped mesh.

Export the optimized asset in FBX, OBJ, or USD format for integration into game engines or digital content creation tools.

Define target polygon count limits before triggering retopology to align asset density directly with engine performance budgets.

Inspect the generated 2D UV island layout and seam positions across high-curvature areas before baking final texture maps.
